sketchMechanisms: Optional chaining returns nil and silently stops evaluation when any link in the chain is nil
The type `Void` is an uninhabited type — no value of type Void can ever be constructed, and `absurd :: Void -> a` promises anything from it, since it can never be called
A finally block executes regardless of whether the try block succeeds or the catch block handles the error — it runs no matter what happens
